message.content:
Based on the image provided, here are the distinct colors I can identify with their corresponding elements:

1. **#3f3d56** - Logo background (dark purple/navy circle at top of login modal)
2. **#d4af37** - Logo text "UNI STATION" (gold/yellow text)
3. **#ffffff** - Modal background (white login form background)
4. **#1877f2** - "Log in" button background (Facebook blue)
5. **#065fd6** - "Log in" button text (white text on blue button)
6. **#1877f2** - Facebook logo in QR code (blue Facebook "f" icon)
7. **#ffffff** - QR code background (white area surrounding the QR code)
8. **#000000** - QR code pattern (black dots in the QR code)
9. **#4267b2** - Facebook header (light blue "Facebook" text at top left)
10. **#e4e6eb** - Input field borders (light blue border around email/phone field)
11. **#90949c** - Password field text placeholder (gray text)
12. **#1877f2** - "Forgotten password?" link (blue text)
13. **#42b72a** - "Create new account" button background (Facebook green)
14. **#ffffff** - "Create new account" button text (white text on green button)
15. **#ccd0d5** - "or" divider text (gray text)
16. **#f0f2f5** - Page background (light gray background behind modal)
17. **#8b9dc3** - "Log in" and "Forgotten account?" links at top right (light blue text)

Note: Some colors like the background image behind the modal appear to be a light map or graphic, but the colors are not distinct enough to provide precise hex codes from this image. The primary brand colors visible are the dark purple/navy (#3f3d56), gold/yellow (#d4af37), and the Facebook brand colors (blue and green) used in the interface elements.
